title: Abinnaeus archive (P.Abinn.; Bell, Martin, Turner, van Berchem 1962); RU «Архив Абиннея»
author: Flavius Abinnaeus (praefectus alae, Dionysias) and correspondents
edition: Oxford 1962 (copyrighted; archive.org lending copy abinnaeusarchive0000hibe); papyri.info text (CC)
ru_evidence: CyberLeninka 'Абинней' returned nothing relevant; HGV records no Russian translations
en_evidence: HGV lists external translations for only 5/83 and papyri.info hosts 2. Translations in the 1962 edition were not verified this session.
other_translations: None recorded beyond the 5 HGV-listed items
value: A self-contained snapshot of the late Roman army and village society under Constantius II: abuses, petitions, the officer's career. Valuable for late antique history teaching.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: late koine, formulaic petitions; some damaged letters
